text:
Your Billing Management product already solves an important problem, and you now need a full stack developer who can extend it with Inventory, Vendor, Payment gateway, Purchase/Sales management, Android API support, and stronger documentation without losing momentum.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience building web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I can help you refine the current product, add new modules in a way that fits the existing system, and keep the codebase organized as the platform grows.

One project I built was embedded customer analytics for a confidential B2B SaaS company. I created usage dashboards inside the product so each customer account could see its own metrics, using React, TypeScript, Recharts, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. That work was rolled out to 140 customer accounts and delivered 3 weeks early. It required careful attention to product structure, data handling, and building features that fit naturally into an existing SaaS workflow.

I also built a multilingual documentation site for Gridbeam Robotics using Next.js, MDX, and Algolia. The site launched in 4 languages with instant search, and support tickets went down 27%. That experience is relevant to your need for proper documentation, especially when product features are expanding and different user groups need clear guidance.

For your billing platform, I would focus on understanding the current architecture first, then breaking the requested additions into clean, maintainable feature areas: inventory, vendors, purchases, sales, payment flows, API support for Android app development, and documentation. I’m comfortable working across frontend and backend concerns, and I can help shape each feature so it is usable, consistent, and easy to extend later.

If you’d like, I can start by reviewing the current product structure and helping prioritize the next set of enhancements based on customer need and implementation effort.
